justification: Array indices derived from attacker-controlled struct fields are used without bounds checking.
analysis: This function takes a const struct nft_chain_type pointer as input which is controlled by the caller. It uses ctype->family and ctype->type as array indices into the chain_type array without validating their bounds. The family and type fields could be maliciously set to cause out-of-bounds array access, potentially leading to memory corruption or information disclosure.
